stages.headline: The line through M₀(x₀; y₀; z₀) with direction a{l; m; n}: x = x₀ + lt, y = y₀ + mt, z = z₀ + nt.

stages.headline: The canonical equations of the line: (x − x₀)/l = (y − y₀)/m = (z − z₀)/n.
stages.headlineEnglish: The canonical equations of the line: (x − x₀)/l = (y − y₀)/m = (z − z₀)/n.
